title: the people we met, the hotel you stayed at (relative clauses 2)
summary: Придаточные без **who / that / which**, когда у придаточной есть своё подлежащее (**the people we met**), и придаточные с предлогом в конце (**the hotel we stayed at**).
ru:
## Когда who / that можно опустить
Если в придаточной части **уже есть** своё подлежащее (I, you, we, she, Tom ...), то **who / that / which** можно не писать.
> The people **(that)** we met were very friendly. = The people we met were very friendly. — Люди, которых мы встретили, были очень дружелюбны.
> Where is the book **(which)** you bought? = Where is the book you bought? — Где книга, которую ты купила?
> The girl **(who)** I saw was Kate. = The girl I saw was Kate.

## Сравните: когда нельзя опускать
Если **who / that / which** — подлежащее придаточной (сразу после него идёт глагол), опускать **нельзя**.
> The man **who lives** next door is a nurse. (после who — глагол lives → нельзя опустить)
> The man **I met** is a nurse. (после man — подлежащее I → who опускаем)

## Предлог в конце
Если глагол в придаточной требует предлога, он стоит **в самом конце** придаточной части, а не перед who.
> This is the hotel **we stayed at**. — Вот отель, в котором мы останавливались.
> The man **I spoke to** was very nice. — Мужчина, с которым я говорила, был очень мил.
> Where is the film **you told me about**? — Где фильм, о котором ты мне говорила?
> The girl **he is looking for** is my sister. — Девушка, которую он ищет, моя сестра.
Можно и с that / which: *the hotel **that / which** we stayed at*.

## Формальный вариант
В русском предлог стоит перед «котором», в английском — в конце.
> ~~the hotel at which we stayed~~ → слишком формально; лучше **the hotel we stayed at**.
> ~~the man to who I spoke~~ → **the man I spoke to**.

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~The girl I saw her was Kate.~~ → The girl **I saw** was Kate. (her лишнее)
- ~~The book which I read it.~~ → The book **(which) I read**.
- ~~The hotel we stayed.~~ → The hotel we stayed **at**. (потерян предлог)
- ~~The man to whom I spoke.~~ — формально; лучше **the man I spoke to**.
en:
## When you can leave out who / that / which
If the relative clause already has its own subject (I, you, we, she, Tom ...), you can leave out **who / that / which**.
> The people **(that)** we met were very friendly. = The people we met were very friendly.
> Where is the book **(which)** you bought? = Where is the book you bought?
> The girl **(who)** I saw was Kate. = The girl I saw was Kate.

## When you can't leave it out
If **who / that / which** is the subject (a verb comes next), you must keep it.
> The man **who lives** next door is a nurse.
> The man **I met** is a nurse.

## Preposition at the end
If the verb needs a preposition, it goes at the **end** of the clause.
> This is the hotel **we stayed at**.
> The man **I spoke to** was very nice.
> Where is the film **you told me about**?
> The girl **he is looking for** is my sister.
You can also use that / which: *the hotel **that / which** we stayed at*.

## Don't repeat the object
> ~~The girl I saw her was Kate.~~ → The girl **I saw** was Kate.
> ~~The book which I read it.~~ → The book **(which) I read**.

## Common mistakes
- ~~The hotel we stayed.~~ → The hotel we stayed **at**.
- ~~The man to who I spoke.~~ → The man **I spoke to**.
structure:
## Схема
| Тип | Конструкция | Пример |
|---|---|---|
| who / that — подлежащее | сущ. + **who** + глагол | The man **who lives** here |
| who / that — дополнение | сущ. + (**who**) + подлежащее + глагол | The man (who) **I met** |
| с предлогом | сущ. + подлежащее + глагол + **предлог** | The hotel **we stayed at** |

## Формулы
> Существительное + **подлежащее + глагол** (без who / that)
> the people **we met** · the film **I saw** · the song **she sings**
> Существительное + подлежащее + глагол + **предлог**
> the person **I talked to** · the key **I'm looking for**

## Запомните
- Нет **who / that** + подлежащее после существительного → слово опущено, это нормально.
- Есть глагол сразу после существительного → **who / that / which** обязательно.
- Предлог — в конце: **for, to, at, about, with, of**.
- Местоимение-дополнение (**her, it, them**) в такой придаточной не повторяем.

exercises.title: Нужно ли who / that?
exercises.instruction: Вставьте **who / that / which**, или **—**, если слово можно опустить.

items.text: The man {{who|that}} lives next door is a dentist.
The book {{—|-|that|which}} I bought was very interesting.
Where is the cake {{that|which}} was on the table?
The girl {{—|-|who|that}} I met yesterday is called Dina.
I like people {{who|that}} laugh a lot.
The film {{—|-|that|which}} we saw was boring.

exercises.title: Предлог в конце
exercises.instruction: Допишите предлог: **at, to, for, about, with, in**.

items.text: This is the hotel we stayed {{at}}.
The woman I spoke {{to|with}} was very kind.
Where is the key you were looking {{for}}?
The film I told you {{about}} is on TV tonight.
The boy she is going out {{with}} is her classmate.
That's the house we lived {{in}} when I was small.
Is this the song you were listening {{to}}?

items.why: **the people we met** — без повторения дополнения.

items.q: The man ___ lives next door is a doctor.

items.why: Предлог остаётся в конце: **the shop I work at**.

items.q: The woman ___ called me was my aunt.
items.why: После woman идёт глагол **called** → нужен who.

items.q: Как сказать «Фильм, который мы посмотрели, был скучным»?
options: The film we saw was boring.
The film we saw it was boring.
The film which we saw it was boring.

items.q: Как сказать «Это отель, в котором мы жили»?
options: This is the hotel we stayed.
This is the hotel we stayed at.
This is the hotel at we stayed.

items.q: Как сказать «Человек, с которым я говорила, — мой сосед»?
options: The man I spoke to is my neighbour.
The man to I spoke is my neighbour.
The man I spoke is my neighbour to.

items.q: Как сказать «Книга, которую я читаю, очень интересная»?
options: The book I'm reading is very interesting.
The book I'm reading it is very interesting.
The book who I'm reading is very interesting.
items.why: Без повторения it, who — для людей.

items.q: Как сказать «Женщина, которая живёт рядом, — врач»?
options: The woman lives next door is a doctor.
The woman who lives next door is a doctor.
The woman she lives next door is a doctor.

exercises.title: Соедините предложения
exercises.instruction: Соедините два предложения. Пропустите **who / that / which**, если можно.
exercises.example: I bought a book. It was boring. → **The book I bought was boring.**

items.prompt: We met some people. They were very nice.
answers: The people we met were very nice.
The people that we met were very nice.
The people who we met were very nice.

items.prompt: I'm looking for some keys. They are in my bag. → The keys ...
answers: The keys I'm looking for are in my bag.
The keys that I'm looking for are in my bag.
The keys which I'm looking for are in my bag.

items.prompt: She sings a song. I love it. → I love the song ...
answers: I love the song she sings.
I love the song that she sings.
I love the song which she sings.

items.prompt: I stayed at a hotel. It was very cheap. → The hotel ...
answers: The hotel I stayed at was very cheap.
The hotel that I stayed at was very cheap.
The hotel which I stayed at was very cheap.

items.prompt: I talked to a man. He was very friendly. → The man ...
answers: The man I talked to was very friendly.
The man that I talked to was very friendly.
The man who I talked to was very friendly.

exercises.title: Переведите на английский
exercises.instruction: Переведите. Не повторяйте дополнение и ставьте предлог в конец.

answers: Where is the film you bought?
Where is the movie you bought?
Where's the film you bought?
Where's the movie you bought?
Where is the film that you bought?
Where is the movie that you bought?
Where is the film which you bought?
Where is the movie which you bought?

items.prompt: Отель, в котором мы остановились, был чистым.
answers: The hotel we stayed at was clean.
The hotel that we stayed at was clean.
The hotel which we stayed at was clean.

items.prompt: Девушка, с которой я говорил, — моя сестра.
answers: The girl I spoke to is my sister.
The girl I talked to is my sister.
The girl that I spoke to is my sister.
The girl that I talked to is my sister.
The girl who I spoke to is my sister.
The girl who I talked to is my sister.

items.prompt: Музыка, которую я слушаю, очень тихая.
answers: The music I listen to is very quiet.
The music I'm listening to is very quiet.
The music that I listen to is very quiet.
The music that I'm listening to is very quiet.
The music which I listen to is very quiet.
The music which I'm listening to is very quiet.
These are the keys I was looking for.
These are the keys that I was looking for.
These are the keys which I was looking for.
Those are the keys I was looking for.
Those are the keys that I was looking for.
Those are the keys which I was looking for.

exercises.title: Напишите о себе
exercises.instruction: Закончите предложения о себе. Проверьте по образцу.

items.prompt: The best film I've seen is ...
items.sample: The best film I've seen is Interstellar.

items.prompt: The person I talk to most is ...
items.sample: The person I talk to most is my best friend.

items.prompt: The place I'd like to go to is ...
items.sample: The place I'd like to go to is Japan.

items.prompt: The last book I read was ...
items.sample: The last book I read was a detective story.
